messages:
jamie: FYI running into a bunch of training jobs hitting severe perf regression after this morning's driver/CUDA 535.54 rollout. Jobs on mixed H100/A100 hosts are dropping NVLink and falling back to SHM/NET.

alex: ugh. numbers?

jamie: 3x p99 token latency, throughput down ~3-4x for inter-node NCCL allreduce. Example NCCL log: 
```
[0] NCCL WARN Call to ncclSend/Recv failed, fallback to NET
[0] P2P: NVLink peers not detected for GPU 1, using SHM
[0] GDRCOPY disabled for peer 2: rmm mismatch
```

maria: any common factor? driver, kernel, firmware?

jamie: all affected nodes got driver 535.54 + CUDA 12.4; unaffected nodes still on 525.x. Also noticed mixed NVSwitch firmware versions across racks.

alex: can you paste `nvidia-smi topo -m` from an affected host?

jamie: pasted below:
```
GPU0 GPU1 GPU2 GPU3 CPU Affinity
GPU0 X NVLink SYS SYS 0-23
GPU1 NVLink X SYS SYS 0-23
GPU2 SYS SYS X NVLink 24-47
GPU3 SYS SYS NVLink X 24-47
```

But NCCL reports different peermap (peers mapped to sockets) causing SHM fallback.

sre-oncall: marking this P1 for infra. I'm going to cordon new-driver nodes in the autoscale pool and route new jobs away.

maria: +1. Also we should capture `dmesg` and `nvidia-p2p` outputs and the kernel module versions.

jamie: grabbing now, attaching CLI snippet I ran:
```bash
for h in $(cat affected_hosts.txt); do ssh $h 'dmesg | tail -n 40; modinfo nvidia | grep ^version; cat /proc/driver/nvidia/gpus/0000:01:00.0/information'; done
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot noticed driver-535.54 rollout completed in us-west-2-gpupool at 08:12 UTC :information_source:

alex: proposal: rollback driver to 525 for mixed racks while we validate NVLink detection fixes. We can keep a small canary on 535 to reproduce.

maria: agree. canary plan: 5 hosts (2 H100, 3 A100) in staging, run NCCL tests (allreduce/allgather) via `nccl-tests` and check `NCCL_P2P_LEVEL`.

jamie: quick test command:
```bash
NCCL_DEBUG=INFO NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=NVL ./build/all_reduce_perf -b 8 -e 4096 -f 2
``` 
Gives `NCCL WARN: Using SHM for peer 2` on 535, but not on 525.

sre-oncall: rolling back 10 nodes now, patching autoscaler to skip driver-535 label. ETA 25m.

alex: also file a kernel/firmware inventory task. Mixed firmware across chassis might be the root cause.

maria: i'll start an eval job to measure p99 and throughput delta across driver versions and attach perf logs to the ticket.

jamie: thanks. tagging @hardware for NVSwitch firmware check. :eyes:

sre-oncall: update: rollback finished for first 10 nodes, jobs starting to recover. keeping monitoring on.

jamie: confirmed two affected training runs dropped back to expected throughput after rollback :tada:

maria: next steps: (1) full canary + nvlink validation scripts (2) hold mass rollout (3) coordinate firmware update schedule. I'll open a tracking ticket.

alex: please add cost impact estimate (we lost ~6 hours compute on 50 nodes) to the ticket.

jamie: noted, will add.

infra-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0113 - NCCL P2P fallback after driver 535 rollout (severity: high)

sre-oncall: closing thread, keep replies in the incident ticket. Thanks all.
